CARMEL, Ind., Sept. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — NeurAxis, Inc. (“NeurAxis,” or the “Company”) (NYSE American: NRXS), a medical technology company commercializing neuromodulation therapies for chronic and debilitating conditions in children and adults, will participate in a webcast presentation and host one-on-one meetings with investors at the Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference, taking place virtually on September 29-30, 2026.


**Company Webcast**


The webcast presentation will take place at 11:45 a.m. ET on Tuesday, September 29, 2026. The webcast can be accessed by visiting the conference website at[https://lythampartners.com/fall2026/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=G9mNlCkJONiCw8F8rHTyslX2pk_IELzvfhdExbkqo2HCfZbDd_ZuHmKsRZ88Hcm3bypDgDpvpGJEyCuT52ybE4aeD81ODLzfrp4UgW9ZqTfTPBgzzSMxM7WAhdYPFoxdDv5n6O7LXgqVZEUoCcgbVA==) or directly at[https://app.webinar.net/lJ5aBmzWwkZ](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=G9mNlCkJONiCw8F8rHTysvHpTW2-pLfWhm7sjkzI3Ur4xD8zg805KKl5lqZ4AO7re6GlnMOCYP4SSfihpevcCt7BrSJ7Z175EBSU5UUIZCvFdBukp1mQJjUMFKqo1wE86IAn7f3Ovu8iT-x5pF2aRw==) . The webcast will also be available for replay following the event.


**1×1 Meetings**


Management will be participating in virtual one-on-one meetings throughout the event. To arrange a meeting with management, please contact Lytham Partners at[1×1@lythampartners.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=tQKFrMJS4167DrlTEdCgWOLw108fXOe4wzwyi_g35JF5snrXO9nthk-j1HrRyx_lrJWbEcWAnB_xRPhr3ufVFOjSIAd1CZpnSHMzA1WQK3k=) or register for the event at[https://lythampartners.com/fall2026invreg/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=G9mNlCkJONiCw8F8rHTyslX2pk_IELzvfhdExbkqo2FG1jMB7CRCuXIP_5RseUEJRTASxxqSXKCGjysAoiloL402fYpi27sKzFwjRXRaXHgiZVjnqAAbx05sHOEL2oofaBNdNJ3h7RfGQ8ff-SPibA==) .


**About NeurAxis, Inc.**


NeurAxis, Inc., is a medical technology company focused on neuromodulation therapies to address chronic and debilitating conditions in children and adults. NeurAxis is dedicated to advancing science and leveraging evidence-based medicine to drive the adoption of IB-Stim, its proprietary Percutaneous Electrical Nerve Field Stimulation (PENFS) technology, by the medical, scientific, and patient communities. IB-Stim is FDA-cleared for functional abdominal pain in irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) and functional dyspepsia, including FD-linked nausea symptoms in patients ages 8 and older. Additional clinical trials of PENFS in multiple pediatric and adult conditions with large unmet healthcare needs are underway.
